full_text:
[message_id=685247 author=Dongyong Lee first=True]
Hi, the rules state:
▎ "To be eligible for any prize, teams must publish a public Kaggle notebook and solution Writeup documenting the methods used to generate their submission."
Could you clarify when this needs to happen — before the competition deadline, or after the competition ends?
Thank you!

[message_id=3433972 author=CPMP first=False]
Before prizes are awarded. Mid point prize are there to encourage sharing. It is your call to go for these prize or wait till competition end.

[message_id=3431249 author=James Weatherhead first=False]
This is a good question… I had the same thought for the mid-point prize too.

[message_id=3430136 author=HADY first=False]
I wonder why would someone downvote for this. Very valid question!

[message_id=3429881 author=Brisa Marina first=False]
We won't know if we are competition winners until after the competition ends. Any required documentation would be submitted after the competition ends.
